senses.gloss: ऋते [ṛtē], ind. Except, without, with the exception of (usually with abl.); ऋते क्रौर्यात्समायातः Bk.8.15; अवेहि मां प्रीतमृते तुरङ्गमात् R.3.63; पापादृते Ś.6.22; Ku. 1.51;2.57; sometimes with acc. ऋते$पि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे Bg.11.32; rarely with instr.
ऋतेन [ṛtēna], ind. Duly, rightly, truly, honestly, justly.
